question: Will Lula appear at TV Globo's presidential debate on October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo is a hard no-show streak: Lula skipped Band (Aug 23), let the 11-outlet Sept 14 debate collapse by missing the Sept 7 confirmation deadline, and skipped the Sept 18 Metropoles online debate for a Guarulhos rally. Veja reported in late August that his absence from the Globo debate had already been communicated to Flavio Bolsonaro's team, and O Globo (Sept 14) reported PT still ruling out first-round debates while planning two runoff appearances. Reference class: incumbents at the final Globo first-round debate are 2/3 historically, but 0/2 conditional on having skipped all earlier first-round debates that cycle - Lula's own 2006 incumbency being the closest analogue. Against that: Estado de Minas/PlatoBR today (Sept 21) reports part of PT pushing for attendance with the decision formally unmade, the race is tight (39-36), and Globo's post-Jornal-Nacional slot is the highest-audience event of the campaign. Structurally, Flavio's camp conditions his attendance on Lula's, so showing up buys Lula a multi-podium format where 4-5 rivals concentrate fire on the incumbent three days before the vote, while a near-certain runoff preserves the 1v1 he says he wants. Polymarket's broader any-debate-by-Oct-3 contract (virtual counts) traded ~36% on low volume; since it strictly dominates this question's terms, it caps rather than anchors my number. Fine print also routes a Globo cancellation to NO.

calls.reconciliation: Runs clustered 0.15-0.22 on a shared evidence base. Factual disputes: (1) the Polymarket price — all three runs report 0.36/$842 while the harness market block reports 0.53 on volume 25,950; three runs citing an identical figure is likely one shared snippet, not independent confirmation, and $842 reads as liquidity rather than volume. Record Sept 27, virtual allowed, no cancellation clause), so it caps rather than sets this number — P(Globo Oct 1 | any debate) ~0.75-0.85 since Globo is the marquee, last, and format-compliant event. (2) Date of the PlatoBR/Estado de Minas 'PT faction pushes for Oct 1, decision not taken' story — Run 1 says Sept 21, Run 3 says early Sept; unsettled, so it carries its uncertainty rather than being decisive. Judgment call I took rather than split: the conditional 0/2 class is directionally right but too thin to support 0.15, and all three runs under-weighted that Globo's TSE-threshold lineup removes PT's own stated objection to the earlier formats. Landing outside (above) all three members is deliberate — the shared low market anchor and the format point are evidence the pool did not price, not a preference for caution.
